title: 08. Whom do I contact if there are technical problems with EUSurvey?
intent: This troubleshooting article helps EUSurvey survey managers resolve or understand the issue: Whom do I contact if there are technical problems with EUSurvey.
short_answer: EU staff should contact their IT helpdesk and ask them to forward the problem to DIGIT-EUSURVEY-SUPPORT, describing it as precisely as possible.
procedure: External users should contact the Commission's CENTRAL HELPDESK (mailto:EC-CENTRAL-HELPDESK@ec.europa.eu? subject=Incident%20Creation%20Request%20for%20DIGIT%20EUSURVEY%20SUPPORT%20&body=%20Dear%20Helpdesk,%0D%0DCould%20you%20please%20open% .
